  transform: translateY(0);
  padding: 0px;
}
.modal .modal-container.image-and-text .modal-button span {
  background-color: #F75F00;
  color: #fff;
  display: block;
  font-family: "AvantGarde Bold", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.3333333333rem;
  padding: 20px;
  text-align: center;

}
.modal .modal-container.image-and-text .modal-content-desktop {
  display: block;
}
.modal-dialog .modal-container .modal-content .modal-body .modal-content-mobile {
  display:none;
}
.modal .modal-container.image-and-text .modal-container-background {
  display:none;
}
.no-button {
  margin-top: 1rem;
}
.no-button a {
  background: url(/sites/all/themes/aspca_2015/images/ico-crosshatch-blue.png) repeat top left;
}

.rounded {
	border-radius: 4px;
}

@media (min-width: 576px) {
        .modal .modal-container.image-and-text #modalClose {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            right: 4px;
            top: -8px;
        }

    }




@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .lightbox h2 {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0 10px;
  }
  .lightbox-image {
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  }
  .lightbox-image img {
    top: 0px;
  }
  .lightbox p {
    text-align: center;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .image-shield-overlay {
    display: none;
  }
  .lightbox {
    grid-template-columns: 50% 50%;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
  .lightbox h2 {
    top: 0;
    font-size: 2.3rem;
  }
  .lightbox p {
    top: 0;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
  .lightbox-text {
    justify-content: space-around;
    padding: 0 0 0 1.5rem;
  }
  .lightbox-text a.link-wrap {
    justify-content: space-between;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
  }
  
  
  .modal .modal-container.image-and-text #modalClose {
    font-size: 2.5rem; 
    right: 6px;
    top: -7px;
  }
  
  
  
  .modal .modal-container.image-and-text .modal-button span {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 20px;
    min-width: 230px;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .modal .modal-container.image-and-text .modal-content {
    max-width: 700px;
  }
  .modal .modal-container.image-and-text .modal-content-desktop {
    display: block;
  }
  .modal .modal-dialog {
    max-width: 700px;
  }
  .no-button {
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
  }
}
